findings: All nine are proposed and their only source is marked unverified; the approval schema requires a nonempty review and at least one verified source.
No verified market evidence establishes the association between each numeric band and its architectural guidance.
The bands are usable as subjective design curation only; area, programme and amenities are explicitly not price formulas.
Adjacent display ranges share endpoints; the parser deterministically selects lower-inclusive bands, so exactly $25m selects 25m–50m.
The phrase property-value or budget context conflates asset value with construction budget; proposed correction separates them.
Repository sources can verify implemented construction and retrieval only; they cannot verify price-band associations.
